text:
First trial of seating from the two instruction files alone (meta-macbook-20261109-1, dd24a84). Seating, `tasks.py next --role meta` and `notes.py list --role meta` worked as written; `bootstrap.py seat meta` printed the exact commit command. Five places made me stop or guess:

1. CLAUDE.md, "Setup on a new clone": `git config committer.name "seat:<role>-<machine>-<YYYYMMDD>-<n>"` and `git config committer.email ...` stand unconditionally and before `python bootstrap.py seat <role>`. In this clone they would overwrite design-macbook-20261106-1's configured committer, they contradict "set the committer for the commit itself ..., not in the repository's configuration" in the same file, and they need <n> before the seat command has given it. contracts/seats.json `adopt` says the same thing. Expected: the block ends with `python bootstrap.py seat <role> --write` and `python contracts/tools/seat_commit.py --seat <name> -m "..." contracts/seats.json`, and the two git config lines are marked for a clone no other seat uses.

2. CLAUDE.md, "Setup on a new clone": nothing says which lines a new session in an existing clone runs. I skipped `git config core.hooksPath`, `bootstrap.py check` and `bootstrap.py install node rea --yes` on a guess. Expected: a short block "A new session in a clone already set up": `python contracts/validate.py`; `python bootstrap.py seat <role> --write`; the seat_commit.py line; `tasks.py next --role <role>`; `notes.py list --role <role>`.

3. CLAUDE.md: "Before writing anything, read `plan.md` sections 3 (MP1-MP13), 6 (cards), 8 (checks) and 9 (seats)" against "registered in its own commit before any other work". The order is not said; I registered first and read after. Expected: one sentence saying which comes first.

4. meta_agent/CLAUDE.md, Working habits: "Where a task has a design part, that part lands first." `tasks.py next --role meta` gives 005, a design+meta task nobody holds, and neither `next` nor `list` says whether its design part has landed, so I cannot tell whether a meta seat may claim 005 now. Expected: `next --role meta` prints the design part's state, or does not offer the task until it has landed.

5. meta_agent/CLAUDE.md writes `python ../contracts/tools/tasks.py` and `python ../contracts/tools/notes.py` (run from meta_agent/), while CLAUDE.md and "`python ../contracts/validate.py` from the repository root" mean the root. I guessed the root; tasks.py and notes.py answered the same from both, seat_commit.py with paths from meta_agent/ I did not try. Expected: one working directory in both files.

Smaller: plan.md 9 says "this computer's tag is `office`", which is wrong when read on the macbook; meta_agent/CLAUDE.md shows `notes.py ask ... --task <id>` as if required, the tool makes it optional, and I named 009 because this note is about its mechanism.
